_comment: USD per 1,000,000 tokens, keyed by model name. Verified 2026-08-16 against https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/pricing (Gemini Developer API, Standard tier, paid) and recorded in docs/research/2026-08-16-gemini-flash-pricing.md. A model with no entry disables --budget-usd, and passing --budget-usd for an unpriced model refuses to start rather than running without a ceiling. Verify any rate you add against the provider's own current page: a rate that is wrong in the cheap direction does not disable the ceiling, it silently raises it, and the run reports success while overspending. These two models are adjacent rows on that page and were previously transposed here.
_gemini_3_7_flash_expiry: WARNING: gemini-3.7-flash and gemini-3.6-flash are on INTRODUCTORY pricing that expires 2026-12-31. On 2027-01-01 both become 1.50 input / 7.50 output — double the rates below. This file has no notion of an effective date, so from that morning these entries are half the real price, and a rate that is wrong on the cheap side does not disable the ceiling, it silently raises it. Update them or delete them before then.
